_about: Every asset the rebuild needs. "in-repo" files are committed. "pending-download" files are on sweillem.net (or the agent site) and are fetched by scripts/fetch-live-assets.mjs, which this container cannot run because its network blocks sweillem.net. publish: yes = usable on the site; internal = reference material (e.g. pictures of spec tables to transcribe); needs-confirmation = ask SWEILLEM first.
